notes: Community plug-in registry for J-Log. Each entry points at a JSON file the j-hub web UI can fetch and drop into ~/.j-log/contests/ or ~/.j-log/awards/ with one click. Submissions: open a PR adding your plug-in to this file. Plug-ins must follow the schemas documented in docs/PLUGINS.md.

contests.name: ARRL International DX (CW) — W/VE side (registry demo)
contests.author: WM3J
contests.description: Same as the bundled ARRL_DX_CW_US — included here only as a demonstration of how a registry entry looks. Real third-party contests will be added as operators contribute them.

awards.name: Worked All States (registry demo)
awards.author: WM3J
awards.description: Mirrors the bundled WAS award — demonstration entry for the registry. Substitute your own award JSON when contributing.
